rationale: Statutory national notice portal under ZJN-3; the creation point for all SI banking/payments tender notices.
Queryable CPV/supplier-parameterised search index behind the portal; distinct collection endpoint despite soft url_verification failure.
Statutory e-tendering system where procedures run and documentation/deadlines live; standalone monitoring target.
Live open-procedure listing on e-JN; earliest structured signal a banking/payments tender is biddable, worth its own poll.
Per-notice permalink pattern on enarocanje.si — the record template harvested via the parent portal, not a separate source.
Official gazette carrying ZJN-3 amendments, thresholds and portal/e-form schema changes that break collectors.
Single consolidated statute page — ground-truth reference for publication duties, not a recurring signal stream.
Regulator/system-owner framing of the same ejn.gov.si URL already kept as c_003; no standalone endpoint.
Statist award-statistics app gives structured, backfillable 2013+ series of who wins SI banking/payments contracts.
CKAN open dataset with API — cheapest bulk machine-readable route into the notice/award stream.
Annual statutory procurement aggregates; low-frequency but useful for spend sizing and coverage checks.
DKOM decision search exposes contested/annulled banking-payments tenders, requirements and bidder names.
ERAR transaction transparency reveals actual public payments to banks, processors and terminal vendors incl. below-threshold.
TED root domain duplicated by the EN search (c_019) and API (c_021) entries kept for this cell.
Operator-affiliated commercial CPV alerting; likely subscription-gated, value is as coverage benchmark and taxonomy reference.
Commercial aggregator whose value is a one-off mine of its coverage map and Slovenian CPV reference.
Small second monitoring service; mine once as a completeness cross-check, unclear access and low credibility.
Third-party CPV-sliced mirror useful as a validation index for CPV 66, but provenance and freshness unverified.
Official EU OJ S notice search; mandatory channel for all above-threshold SI banking/payments notices, CPV-filterable.
Slovenian localisation of the same TED corpus; useful for glossary but a language variant of the kept TED search.
Anonymous-access TED v3 search API — highest-leverage automated collection route for the whole A2 cell.
Static technical documentation needed to write correct queries; reference material, not a signal producer.
Bulk XML editions enable a one-off historical backfill plus recurring daily packages for SI notices.
